["Beautiful Hotel,We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here.The hotel is Modern and fresh with beautiful pool and outdoor areas.There are swimming pools for families and also separate pools for those wanting to chill.The rooms are fantastic,very big and modern with walk in showers and lovely balconies with sun loungers.The breakfast is fantastic loads to choose from and the pool side bars food was lovely too.The staff are extremely nice and friendly.The Spa treatments are amazing I would highly recommended them.The Hotel is spotlessly clean.I would definitely go back to this Hotel as it honestly ticks all the boxes,it has something for everyone.", "Our second stay in Radisson Blu Mogán, we enjoyed it even more !
